name: context-menu
title: Context Menu
description: "A menu of actions for an element: a secondary click opens it at the pointer, a touch and hold opens it beside the element over a dimmed page, as iOS 26 context menus do. Its items are the ones of Menu."
docs: Import as `import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuTrigger, MenuItem, MenuSeparator } from '@/components/ui/context-menu'`. See https://plexui.com/vue/components/context-menu for props and examples.
